title: About this wiki
summary: An official, maintained guide to Nightcap.
body:
Production loot data

The loot finder preview uses a public projection of item, NPC, zone and loot content. A server-side reader is prepared to refresh it every fifteen minutes; the capture time is visible. It exposes no accounts, characters, passwords or database connection. Browser filters and item links use the public capture. Drop chances are calculated from database rules and may differ from saved loot, unreloaded caches or scripted rewards. The feature remains not released until its reader and public route are installed.

What you will find here

This wiki is maintained by the server owner and their development assistant. It documents Nightcap’s custom systems and the currently released zone-reward catalog. It is not a complete database of every ordinary item, NPC, map or quest.

The design follows the familiar wiki pattern of articles, topic directories, contents and cross-links. Nightcap’s own documentation and approved artwork supply the content; external wiki articles are not copied.

Make it your field guide

Choose a path on the home page: start playing, build a character, find gear, or go adventuring. Quick search finds guides, items and zones as you type; press / or Ctrl+K (Command+K on Mac) when you are not typing in another field. Escape closes the search.

Use Save this guide on an article to add it to your field notes, then open Saved guides to return or remove it. Light and dark reading modes are available in the navigation. Your saved pages and theme preference stay in this browser’s local storage; they are not sent to the server or synced between devices. If storage is blocked, changes last for the current page visit.

Articles and directory links remain available without JavaScript. Home-page release notices can be expanded under Release notes & live testing.

Reading release labels

  • Live testing: installed or published for play, with gameplay or visual acceptance still ongoing.
  • Not released: candidate or planned work; not an available feature.
  • Reference: navigation, help or editorial information.

Each article has a review date. Balance and availability can change. The wiki is reviewed as part of every Nightcap change. A player-facing update includes its affected guides, Features entry, command and catalog pages, and dated release notes. Candidate work stays labeled until its deployment is verified.

Suggest a correction

Send the server owner the article title and the correction. For a gameplay problem, include your classes, level, zone, approximate time, and the item, NPC, spell or ability involved. If an action may have lost items or currency, include before-and-after amounts and stop retrying until it has been checked.

Public reading, official editing

Anyone can read this wiki. Editing is maintained by the owner; there are no public accounts or edit forms. The wiki uses no analytics, cookies or external fonts. Search runs in your browser against a public article index. Hosting providers may retain ordinary request logs. Public wiki access does not grant access to the private player site or game.
